descriptions.w3d_construct_three_pair_control_802c6b1: Initialize the original28-byte base, three native held-interface pairs, shared text, global vector and scalar defaults, then release/reclear two interfaces and assign the observed identifier, minus-one, enabled and zero fields through byte131. Native pair placement constructors retain the original count-loop lifetimes. Names and roles inferred; no complete semantic class or external data ownership is claimed.
